title: Secret-like values are present in tracked material
plain: A secret-like value appears in tracked Atlas material; if real, it could expose private data.
verify_by: Inspect flagged values without exposing them and confirm they are synthetic or rotate any real credential.
owner_action: Confirm whether any flagged value is real and rotate it outside Atlas if so.
stopgap: Do not use any flagged credential; revoke it if real.
evidence: Secret-shaped values were found in a work-log test and two fixtures; confirm they are synthetic.
correction: Remove real credentials, replace fixtures with placeholders, and add a scan gate.
test_plan: Run the secret scan after replacement and confirm no usable credential remains.
control: Secrets must not be committed or retained in logs.
